description: This file defines the 'tlInventory' PHP class, which manages inventory items such as servers and machines within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting inventory data, as well as validating server names and IP addresses. The class interacts with a database to persist inventory information and provides functionality to retrieve current inventory data.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: Manages test environment inventory items including creation, modification, retrieval, and deletion of server and machine inventory data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new tlInventory object with a given test project ID and optional database handler.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the tlInventory object is destroyed.

methods.name: initInventoryData
methods.description: Populates inventory properties from input data.

methods.name: getCurrentData
methods.description: Returns the current inventory data as an object.

methods.name: readDB
methods.description: Retrieves inventory data from the database based on provided IDs and options.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Inserts or updates inventory data into the database.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes an inventory item from the database.

methods.name: deleteInventory
methods.description: Deletes a specific inventory item identified by ID.

methods.name: setInventory
methods.description: Creates or updates an inventory item with provided data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all inventory items for the project, with optional detail level.

methods.name: checkInventoryData
methods.description: Validates the inventory data such as server name and IP to avoid duplicates and ensure correctness.

methods.name: getAuditData
methods.description: Fetches audit information related to the test project for logging purposes.
